meta.name: 应用 API Key 汇总
meta.description: 当前调用者的应用 API Key，按应用标记分组。

nodes.alias: 查询应用及当前用户的 Key

sql.value:
WITH caller AS (
 SELECT r.created_by, a.workspace_id
 FROM flow_runs r JOIN applications a ON a.id = r.application_id
 WHERE r.id = '{{sys.workflow_run_id}}'::uuid
 AND r.application_id = '{{sys.application_id}}'::uuid
), app_groups AS (
 SELECT a.id, a.name FROM applications a JOIN caller c ON c.workspace_id = a.workspace_id
 WHERE a.application_type = 'agent_flow'
), key_rows AS (
 SELECT k.id, k.name, k.application_id, a.name AS application_name, k.token_prefix,
 k.creator_user_id, k.enabled, k.expires_at, k.last_used_at, k.created_at, k.updated_at
 FROM api_keys k JOIN app_groups a ON a.id = k.application_id JOIN caller c ON c.created_by = k.creator_user_id
 WHERE k.key_kind = 'application_api_key' AND k.enabled = true AND k.scope_id = c.workspace_id
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'applications', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) ORDER BY a.name, a.id) FROM app_groups a), '[]'::jsonb),
 'items', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(k) ORDER BY k.created_at DESC, k.id DESC) FROM key_rows k), '[]'::jsonb)
) AS catalog;

nodes.alias: 输出 Key 列表及应用分组
